commentary.text: 121' The winner of this match has been decided with the last kick from the penalty spot.
121' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) converts the penalty with ease by slotting the ball into the bottom left corner of the goal after the goalkeeper guesses wrong and dives the opposite way!

121' Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the top of the net. His effort isn't powerful nor precise enough, allowing Bono to keep the ball out of the net.
121' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort crashes against the left post.
121' Quinten Timber (Netherlands) misses the penalty! His poor effort goes well wide of the left post.
121' Goal! Chemsdine Talbi (Morocco) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Bart Verbruggen into right side of the goal.
121' GOAL! Wout Weghorst (Netherlands) sends the penalty high into the top left hand corner of the net.
121' Goal! Bart Verbruggen gets a hand on the penalty from Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
121' Justin Kluivert (Netherlands) fails to convert the penalty kick! His effort hits the left post.
121' Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort only crashes against the crossbar.
121' Goal! Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Bono into the bottom right corner.
121' A penalty shootout is the most dramatic part of any football match and this one is about to start.
120+2' Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle and ends extra time of today's match. The penalty shoot-out will determine the winner.
120' We will have 1 min. of added time.
116' The game is interrupted now, Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
113' Here is a change. Cody Gakpo is going off and Ronald Koeman gives the last tactical orders to Justin Kluivert (Netherlands).
112' Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
110' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marten de Roon (Netherlands) comes onto the pitch for Frenkie de Jong.
107' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
106' Wilton Sampaio has blown his whistle to start the second period of extra time.
105+1' The first period of extra time has ended and the second period will start shortly after the break.
105' Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle for a foul.
101' Morocco keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
97' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) takes the corner but it's cleared.

96' What a wasted opportunity by Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but Bart Verbruggen makes an astonishing save to thwart him. Good work from Morocco as they win a corner.
92' Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
91' The first period of extra-time has just started.
90+8' The referee has ended the second half.
90+5' The ball is cleared after Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+5' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Wilton Sampaio who sees an offensive foul.
90+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Issa Diop (Morocco) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Chemsdine Talbi and easily beat the keeper with a header into the top right corner from close range. 1:1.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
87' Substitution. Bilal El Khannouss makes way for Chemsdine Talbi (Morocco).
86' Ronald Koeman has decided to substitute Ryan Gravenberch and he is replaced by Quinten Timber (Netherlands).
86' The substitution has been made. Jorrel Hato (Netherlands) has replaced Micky van de Ven.
86' Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Azzedine Ounahi.
86' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
84' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands).
83' 35:65 – the latest ball possession ratio.
81' Ryan Gravenberch (Netherlands) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
79' Mohamed Ouahbi decides to make a substitution. Ayyoub Bouaddi will be replaced by Samir El Mourabet (Morocco).
79' Here comes a substitution. Brahim Diaz is given a rest as he is replaced by Gessime Yassine (Morocco).
78' Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) prepares to take a corner kick.
77' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Morocco) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. Morocco will take a corner kick.
75' Mohamed Ouahbi is forced to make a change. Chadi Riad (Morocco) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Anass Salah-Eddine.
72' 1 - 0 Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home low into the middle of the net. The goalkeeper was helpless.
72' The attendance for today's match is 51243.
71' Ronald Koeman prepares a substitution. Brian Brobbey is replaced by Wout Weghorst (Netherlands).
71' Substitution. Nathan Ake makes his way off the pitch and Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands) comes on as his replacement.
67' The referee blows for a cooling break.
66' Morocco keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
63' The corner by Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
62' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Achraf Hakimi (Morocco). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. Morocco have a corner.
62' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) will deliver the corner kick.
61' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
61' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball goes out of play. Morocco are awarded a corner kick.
59' Ryan Gravenberch (Netherlands) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
58' Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Bart Verbruggen easily deals with the threat.
58' Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
56' Brian Brobbey (Netherlands) is flagged for offside.
52' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the crossbar to safety.

49' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Morocco) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Netherlands.

48' Micky van de Ven (Netherlands) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Bono didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
47' Issa Diop (Morocco) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
46' Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
45+5' Dangerous play by Micky van de Ven (Netherlands). Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Morocco will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
45+3' Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
45+3' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
45' The foul by Brian Brobbey (Netherlands) was seen by Wilton Sampaio who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45' Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) is about to take a corner kick.

44' Micky van de Ven (Netherlands) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Bono easily deals with the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Netherlands.
39' Jan Paul van Hecke (Netherlands) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
38' Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

37' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) makes a good late run into the box and times his jump perfectly to get on the end of the corner kick, but his close-range header is brilliant blocked to deny him a certain goal.
37' Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) will take the corner.
35' Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
33' Flag up against Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
31' Foul! Ismael Saibari (Morocco) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
27' Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) attempts to find Achraf Hakimi, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
27' Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) makes a strong challenge and Wilton Sampaio blows for a foul.
23' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
21' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) steps up to send the ball in.

21' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Bart Verbruggen pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The linesman points to the corner flag, Morocco are going to take it.
20' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Morocco) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Netherlands will have a goal kick.
20' Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
19' Corner kick. Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) is ready to send the ball into the box.
16' Flag goes up against Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
12' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
10' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Ismael Saibari (Morocco) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
7' Ryan Gravenberch (Netherlands) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
5' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
4' Frenkie de Jong (Netherlands) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Wilton Sampaio has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
3' The resulting corner, taken by Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands), comes to nothing.
